text:
Marta - PM: FYI I'm sketching a 2026+ roadmap doc that ties routing policies to customer-driven launch gates. Want quick alignment before I push to the repo.
Ajay - Eng: +1. Can we capture the cost vs latency tradeoffs per policy? that's what customers actually ask about.
Devin - Architect: For multi-region, we should enumerate failure modes per route (latency spike, region outage, burst overload). Each needs a different fallback path.
Kevin - Sales: BankCorp and HealthSys both asked for tenant isolation + residency contracts last week. They'll need explicit launch criteria.
Marta - PM: OK noted. My plan: produce a short gating matrix that maps customer asks -> required infra changes -> acceptance metrics -> approximate effort.
Sam - Security: Add KMS/HSM and audit retention requirements as hard gates for regulated customers. No compromise there.
Ajay - Eng: Quick question: do we treat "soft isolation" (logical affinity + quotas) separately from "hard isolation" (dedicated pools)? customers expect clear migration paths.
Devin - Architect: Yes. Proposal: taxonomy = [soft-affinity, slice-affinity, dedicated-pool]. Each gets supported routing policy + fallback semantics.
Kevin - Sales: Can you show example runbooks? Sales needs to explain the cutover story to procurement.
Marta - PM: I'll include a concise runbook example and an exec-level checklist. Draft acceptance criteria will look like:
```
- Functional: requests route to intended lane 99.9% in steady state
- Resilience: failover to fallback model variant within 3s for 95% of simulated region outages
- Cost: per-token delta vs baseline <= 2x for hard-isolation customers (negotiable)
- Security: KMS integration and audit logs enabled by default for private deployments
- Observability: per-model latency and token cost dashboards available + alerting
```
Ajay - Eng: Sim tests + perf harness need to be called out. We should include sequence-length buckets in perf estimates.
Devin - Architect: Also capture KV cache behavior differences between isolation modes. Cache miss storms could blow cost.
Sam - Security: Add note about on-prem HSM compatibility matrix. Some customers run old HSM firmware.
Kevin - Sales: Suggested prioritization: 1) Hard isolation for top-3 regulated customers, 2) soft-affinity for mid-market, 3) automation & tooling general availability.
Marta - PM: Sounds reasonable. Quick poll: are we ok committing to a Q3 pilot for dedicated pools (one customer, one region) and Q4 broader pilot for soft-affinity?
Ajay - Eng: Q3 pilot works if infra slots are available. Need to reserve GPU pool and quota. @ops-bot can you check infra calendar?
ops-bot: infra-calendar: reserved 2xA100 slots for pilot window 2026-07-15 -> 2026-08-15 (tentative).
Devin - Architect: I'll draft the routing policy DSL examples and a small backward-compat migration path doc.
Marta - PM: Great. I'll stitch this into a short product brief and the gating matrix. Will tag owners and add acceptance metrics. Anyone object to this timeline?
Sam - Security: No objections, just want the HSM matrix in the first draft.
Kevin - Sales: Fine from GTM. I'll align with the two pilot customers and get their buy-in.
Ajay - Eng: We'll put a perf/chaos test plan in the PR.
Marta - PM: Thanks all — I'll post the draft doc later today. :rocket:
